founded_year.quote: Originally, the HOSE was officially opened as a securities trading center in 2000 and then upgraded to a stock exchange in 2007.

history.zh: 2021年越南「一个集中交易所」改革：依《证券法》54/2019/QH14 与总理 37/2020/QĐ-TTg 设立越南交易所（VNX）作母公司，HOSE 与河内证券交易所（HNX）成为其两家独立法人子公司；VNX 于2021年12月11日正式挂牌
history.en: The 2021 "one concentrated stock exchange" reform: under the Law on Securities No. 54/2019/QH14 and PM Decision No. 37/2020/QD-TTg, the Vietnam Exchange (VNX) was set up as the parent, with HOSE and the Hanoi Stock Exchange (HNX) becoming its two separately-incorporated subsidiaries; VNX was officially launched on 11 December 2021
history.detail:
改革前 HOSE（胡志明，主板股票）与 HNX（河内，早期为主板 + 后来的 UPCoM、政府债券、
衍生品）各自独立。VNX 为国家 100% 持股的一人有限责任公司、注册资本 3 万亿越南盾、
总部设河内，统一设计与升级两所 IT 系统、颁布上市 / 交易 / 披露 / 会员规则、监督两所。
两所仍是不同法人（different legal status）、各自运营。VNX 之上是国家证券委员会（SSC）。

history.quote: On 11 December 2021, the VNX was officially launched. The VNX and its subsidiaries (the Hanoi Stock Exchange and the Ho Chi Minh Stock Exchange) perform the function of organizing the securities market in Vietnam and operate under the management and supervision of the State Securities Commission (SSC).

organization_form.en: State-owned: the Vietnam Exchange (VNX) is an enterprise with over 50% (in fact 100%) of charter capital held by the State, and HOSE is its single-member limited-liability subsidiary; managed and supervised by the State Securities Commission

foreign_ownership_limit.detail:
待坐实。越南外资持股上限（room）由政府令 155/2020/NĐ-CP 第139条规定（经

opening_mechanism.zh: 开盘集合竞价（Khớp lệnh định kỳ mở cửa），09h00–09h15 集中申报，按「成交量最大」原则确定开盘价：选中价位上所有更优买单 / 卖单必须全部成交；有多个满足的价位时取一方全部成交、对手方全部或部分成交的价位，仍多个则取最接近最近成交价者
opening_mechanism.en: Opening call auction (Khớp lệnh định kỳ mở cửa), order collection 09:00–09:15, opening price set on the maximum-executable-volume principle: at the chosen price all better-priced buy/sell orders must fully execute; where several prices qualify, the one at which one side fully executes and the other side fully or partly executes; if still several, the one nearest the most recent traded price
opening_mechanism.detail: ATO 订单仅在开盘集合竞价时段有效、出清后自动撤销；ATO 不优先于此前已进入系统的涨停价买入限价单 / 跌停价卖出限价单（KRX 系统 2025 年改革要点）。

sources.title: VNX QĐ 22 第19(c)条（ATO 订单）+ 第22(2)条（集合竞价定价原则）

opening_mechanism.quote: Lệnh ATO được nhập vào hệ thống trong thời gian khớp lệnh định kỳ để xác định giá mở cửa. Sau thời điểm xác định giá mở cửa, lệnh không được thực hiện hoặc phần còn lại của lệnh không được thực hiện hết sẽ tự động bị hủy. Lệnh ATO không được ưu tiên trước lệnh giới hạn mua giá trần hoặc lệnh giới hạn bán giá sàn đã nhập vào hệ thống trước đó.

closing_mechanism.zh: 收盘集合竞价（Khớp lệnh định kỳ đóng cửa），14h30–14h45 集中申报，按与开盘相同的「成交量最大」原则确定收盘价；接收 LO 与 ATC 订单，ATC 出清后失效
closing_mechanism.en: Closing call auction (Khớp lệnh định kỳ đóng cửa), order collection 14:30–14:45, closing price set on the same maximum-volume principle as the open; accepts LO and ATC orders, ATC lapses after the uncrossing
closing_mechanism.quote: Khớp lệnh định kỳ 14h30 - 14h45 | Lệnh giới hạn (LO), Lệnh giao dịch tại mức giá khớp lệnh xác định giá đóng cửa (ATC) ... Lệnh ATC được nhập vào hệ thống trong thời gian khớp lệnh định kỳ để xác định giá đóng cửa. Sau thời điểm xác định giá đóng cửa, lệnh không được thực hiện hoặc phần còn lại của lệnh không được hiện hết sẽ hết hiệu lực.

spec.note: 全电子中央订单簿、价格-时间优先连续 + 集合竞价撮合；普通股票无场内做市商。做市商制度限于备兑权证（CW）与 ETF，做市商仅下限价单、按合同承担报价义务——订单驱动之上的补充（同 jp-jpx / hk-hkex，[ADR-043]）
spec.zh: 订单驱动：交易通过撮合方式（khớp lệnh，价格-时间优先）与协议方式（thỏa thuận）进行；普通股票无场内做市商；做市商制度限于备兑权证与 ETF、按合同报价
spec.en: Order-driven: trading is via the order-matching method (khớp lệnh, price-then-time priority) and the negotiated/put-through method (thỏa thuận); ordinary shares have no on-exchange market makers; market making is limited to covered warrants and ETFs under contract

execution_model.detail: enum 依据 matching_principle（价格-时间优先）+ market_maker_scheme（限 CW/ETF、激励型）综合判定为 order_driven（「hybrid vs order_driven」为综合判断，confidence: medium）。

sources.title: 财政部通函 120/2020/TT-BTC 英译第3条 / 第12条（做市）

execution_model.quote: The Stock Exchange organizes securities trading according to the concentrated order matching method and agreement based trading method and the following principles: a) The concentrated order matching method on the securities trading system must ensure the priority principle of price and time

matching_principle.zh: 价格优先、时间优先：买单价高者优先、卖单价低者优先；同价位则先进入系统者优先。集合竞价取成交量最大的价位；连续竞价按订单簿上等待的对手方订单价格成交
matching_principle.en: Price priority then time priority: higher-priced buy orders and lower-priced sell orders rank first; at the same price, the earlier order ranks first. The periodic auction uses the maximum-volume price; continuous matching executes at the price of the waiting counter-order on the book

sources.title: VNX QĐ 22 第22(1)条（撮合优先原则）

matching_principle.quote: Hệ thống giao dịch thực hiện so khớp các lệnh mua và lệnh bán chứng khoán theo nguyên tắc thứ tự ưu tiên về giá và thời gian, cụ thể như sau: a) Ưu tiên về giá: - Lệnh mua có mức giá cao hơn được ưu tiên thực hiện trước. - Lệnh bán có mức giá thấp hơn được ưu tiên thực hiện trước. b) Ưu tiên về thời gian: Trường hợp các lệnh mua hoặc lệnh bán có cùng mức giá thì lệnh nhập vào hệ thống giao dịch trước sẽ được ưu tiên thực hiện trước.

spec.note: HOSE 附录 II 列示的订单类型：LO（限价单）、MTL（市价转限价单，连续竞价专用，未成交余量转为末笔成交价 ±1 报价单位的限价单）、ATO（开盘集合竞价专用）、ATC（收盘集合竞价专用）。无 MOK / MAK（那两类为 HNX 专用）、无冰山 / 隐藏单。LO 有效至收盘集合竞价结束或被撤销 → tif=day

order_types.zh: HOSE 订单类型：LO（限价单，可在连续与集合竞价输入，有效至收盘集合竞价结束或撤销）、MTL（市价转限价单，仅连续竞价，无对手盘即撤，未全部成交部分转为末笔成交价 ±1 报价单位的限价单）、ATO（仅开盘集合竞价）、ATC（仅收盘集合竞价）
order_types.en: HOSE order types: LO (limit order, usable in continuous and auction phases, valid until the closing auction ends or cancelled); MTL (market-to-limit, continuous phase only, cancelled if no counterparty, unfilled remainder converts to a limit order at the last match price ±1 tick); ATO (opening auction only); ATC (closing auction only)
order_types.detail: MP / MOK / MAK 在 QĐ22 第19条中定义，但附录 II 的 HOSE 表只启用 LO 与 MTL（HNX 表另启用 MOK / MAK）。stop / stop_limit / 冰山 / 隐藏单：HOSE 交易系统不提供。

sources.title: VNX QĐ 22 第19条（订单类型）+ 附录 II（HOSE 各时段可用订单类型）

order_types.quote: Lệnh giới hạn (ký hiệu lệnh LO) ... Lệnh thị trường giới hạn (ký hiệu lệnh MTL) là lệnh nếu không được thực hiện toàn bộ thì phần còn lại của lệnh được chuyển thành lệnh LO mua với mức giá cao hơn mức giá khớp lệnh cuối cùng một đơn vị yết giá ... Lệnh giao dịch tại mức giá khớp lệnh xác định giá mở cửa (ký hiệu lệnh ATO) ... Lệnh giao dịch tại mức giá khớp lệnh xác định giá đóng cửa (ký hiệu lệnh ATC)

spec.full_table_note: 股票与封闭式基金按价格分三档：< 10,000 đ → 10 đ；10,000–49,950 đ → 50 đ；≥ 50,000 đ → 100 đ。ETF 与备兑权证：所有价位统一 10 đ。协议交易：1 đ
spec.note: 股票 / 封闭式基金三档 10 / 50 / 100 đ；ETF·CW 恒 10 đ；协议交易 1 đ

tick_size.zh: 报价单位（đơn vị yết giá）：股票、封闭式基金按价格分档——低于 10,000 đ 为 10 đ，10,000–49,950 đ 为 50 đ，50,000 đ 及以上为 100 đ；ETF 与备兑权证所有价位统一 10 đ；协议交易 1 đ
tick_size.en: Quotation unit (đơn vị yết giá): for stocks and closed-end funds, tiered by price — 10 đ below 10,000 đ, 50 đ for 10,000–49,950 đ, and 100 đ at 50,000 đ and above; ETFs and covered warrants use a flat 10 đ at all price levels; put-through trades use 1 đ

sources.title: VNX QĐ 22 附录 II 第1.2项（报价单位表）

tick_size.quote: Đơn vị yết giá | Mức giá | Đơn vị yết giá | Cổ phiếu, chứng chỉ quỹ đóng | <10.000 | 10 đồng | 10.000-49.950 | 50 đồng | > 50.000 | 100 đồng | Chứng chỉ quỹ ETF, chứng quyền có bảo đảm | Áp dụng đơn vị yết giá 10 đồng cho tất cả các mức giá | Đơn vị yết giá đối với giao dịch thỏa thuận là 1 đồng

board_lot_size.zh: 撮合交易的整手单位为 100 股（股票 / 封闭式基金 / ETF / 备兑权证），单笔撮合订单上限 500,000；大宗（lô lớn）最低 20,000；碎股（lô lẻ）1–99 股，见 odd_lot_handling
board_lot_size.en: The round-lot unit for order-matching is 100 (shares / closed-end fund / ETF / covered warrant), with a single order capped at 500,000; a large lot (lô lớn) is a minimum of 20,000; odd lots (lô lẻ) are 1–99 shares, see odd_lot_handling
board_lot_size.detail: QĐ22 第29条规定交易单位由 SGDCK 依第14(4)条公告、VNX 经 SSC 同意后可调整；具体数值载于附录 II。

sources.title: VNX QĐ 22 附录 II 第1.1项（交易单位表）+ 第29条

board_lot_size.quote: Đơn vị giao dịch | Cổ phiếu, chứng chỉ quỹ đóng, chứng chỉ quỹ ETF, chứng quyền có bảo đảm | - Đơn vị giao dịch lô chẵn ... 100, khối lượng tối đa là 500.000 | - Đơn vị giao dịch lô lẻ 1, khối lượng tối đa là 99 | - Đơn vị giao dịch lô lớn 1, khối lượng tối thiểu là 20.000

odd_lot_handling.zh: 碎股（lô lẻ）1–99 股，可通过集中撮合与协议方式交易；碎股只能下 LO 限价单、修改撤销规则同整手；碎股交易单位 1 股；碎股价格遵守与整手相同的价格规则；碎股成交不用于确定参考价与指数价；新上市 / 复牌后 25 日内的碎股在整手撮合价确立前不进系统
odd_lot_handling.en: Odd lots (lô lẻ) are 1–99 shares, tradable via centralised matching and the negotiated method; only LO orders are allowed for odd lots, with the same amend/cancel rules as round lots; the odd-lot trading unit is 1 share; odd-lot prices follow the same price rules as round lots; odd-lot trades are not used to determine the reference price or index prices; newly-listed / post-25-day-suspension odd lots are not accepted until a round-lot match price is established

sources.title: VNX QĐ 22 第34条（碎股交易）

odd_lot_handling.quote: Giao dịch lô lẻ được thực hiện theo phương thức khớp lệnh tập trung và phương thức giao dịch thỏa thuận trên hệ thống giao dịch. Nhà đầu tư chỉ được phép nhập lệnh LO đối với giao dịch lô lẻ ... Đơn vị giao dịch lô lẻ là 01 cổ phiếu hoặc chứng chỉ quỹ hoặc chứng quyền có bảo đảm ... Các lệnh giao dịch lô lẻ không được sử dụng để xác định giá tham chiếu, giá tính chỉ số.

type.zh: 百分比涨跌幅（biên độ dao động giá），主板股票 / 基金常规 ±7%，特殊情形 ±20%
type.en: Percentage price band (biên độ dao động giá), a regular ±7% for main-board stocks/funds and ±20% in special cases

sources.title: VNX QĐ 22 附录 II 第1.3–1.4项（价格波动幅度表）

type.quote: Biên độ dao động giá | #7% so với giá tham chiêu

spec.note: 常规 ±7%（含向现有股东出售库存股的除权日）；±20% 适用于：新上市股票 / 基金的首个交易日至整手撮合价确立；停牌 / 暂停交易连续 25 个交易日以上后复牌至整手撮合价确立；企业分立 / 以库存股派息送股 / 现金股息不低于前收盘价 的除权日与复牌日

main_board.zh: 常规涨跌幅 ±7%（相对参考价）；±20% 适用于新上市首日至整手撮合价确立、连续 25 交易日以上停牌后复牌、以及企业分立 / 库存股派息送股 / 大额现金股息等除权 / 复牌情形。涨停价 = 参考价 +（参考价 × 幅度），跌停价 = 参考价 -（参考价 × 幅度），涨停向下取整、跌停向上取整到报价单位
main_board.en: Regular band ±7% (against the reference price); ±20% applies to the first trading day of a newly-listed stock/fund until a round-lot match price is set, resumption after 25 or more consecutive trading days of suspension, and certain ex-rights/resumption cases (company split, stock dividend/bonus from treasury shares, large cash dividend). Ceiling = reference + (reference × band), floor = reference − (reference × band), with the ceiling rounded down and the floor rounded up to the tick unit

sources.title: VNX QĐ 22 附录 II 第1.3–1.4项 + 第31–32条

main_board.quote: Biên độ dao động giá | #7% so với giá tham chiêu ... Biên độ dao động giá trong ngày giao dịch đầu tiên của cỗ phiếu, chứng chỉ quỹ đóng, chứng chỉ quỹ ETF ... +20% so với giá tham chiếu ... Giá trần = Giá tham chiếu + (Giá tham chiếu x Biên độ dao động giá) Giá sàn = Giá tham chiếu - (Giá tham chiếu x Biên độ dao động giá)

other_boards.zh: HOSE 只有一个上市板（见第六章 boards）；受限制交易（bị hạn chế giao dịch）证券只在集合竞价方式下交易（开盘集合竞价 + 若干 15 分钟定期集合竞价 + 收盘集合竞价），涨跌幅仍为 ±7%
other_boards.en: HOSE has a single listing board (see chapter 6 boards); securities under a trading restriction (bị hạn chế giao dịch) trade only via the auction method (opening auction + a series of 15-minute periodic auctions + closing auction), with the same ±7% band

sources.title: VNX QĐ 22 附录 II 第1项（受限制交易证券的交易安排）

spec.note: 《证券法》配套通函 120/2020/TT-BTC 第5条授权交易所经 SSC 批准可设「熔断机制」（cơ chế ngắt mạch thị trường），QĐ22 第17条引用该条；但截至 2026 年越南未启用全市场 / 指数级熔断，日内价格约束仅为 ±7% / ±20% 涨跌幅

circuit_breaker.zh: 无。通函 120/2020/TT-BTC 第5条与 QĐ22 第17条为「熔断机制」预留了法律依据（由交易所经 SSC 批准设定），但越南目前未实际启用全市场或指数级熔断；日内波动由 ±7% / ±20% 涨跌幅控制
circuit_breaker.en: None. Article 5 of Circular 120/2020/TT-BTC and Article 17 of QĐ22 reserve a legal basis for a circuit breaker mechanism (to be defined by the exchange upon SSC approval), but Vietnam does not currently operate any market-wide or index-level circuit breaker; intraday volatility is contained by the ±7%/±20% price bands

sources.title: 财政部通函 120/2020/TT-BTC 英译第5条（Circuit breaker）
VNX QĐ 22 第17条（引用通函 120 第5条）

circuit_breaker.quote: The Stock Exchange shall, upon the State Securities Commission's approval, define the circuit breaker mechanism. Based on the practical market conditions, the State Securities Commission shall decide to apply the circuit breaker mechanism or the circuit breaker mechanism combined with price fluctuation limit.

spec.note: 未见独立于 ±7% / ±20% 日内涨跌幅之外的个股级波动性中断 / 冷静期集合竞价机制（如 HKEX VCM、Eurex Volatility Interruption 那类）；日内价格出界即被涨跌停挡下，不触发额外的临时集合竞价

volatility_interruption.zh: 无独立的个股级波动性中断机制。日内价格由 ±7% / ±20% 涨跌停硬约束，触及即无法越过，不设「触及价格走廊 → 短暂集合竞价 → 恢复」这类冷静期安排
volatility_interruption.en: No separate stock-level volatility interruption. Intraday prices are hard-bounded by the ±7%/±20% limits and cannot move beyond them; there is no "price collar breach → brief auction → resume" cooling-off arrangement
volatility_interruption.detail: 「无」为消极认定——QĐ22 第五章交易条款未出现波动性中断 / 冷静期条款，附录 II 时间表也无对应时段。若后续 KRX 系统引入此类机制需复核。

VNX QĐ 22/QĐ-HĐTV 附录 II（HOSE 交易时间表 + 交易单位 / 报价单位 / 价格波动幅度 表）

trading_halt_mechanism.zh: 全市场层面：VNX 依《证券法》第49(1)条可临时停止 / 暂停交易系统运行，恢复依第49(2)条。个股层面：QĐ22 第六章设有警告（Cảnh báo）、控制（Kiểm soát）、限制交易（Hạn chế giao dịch）、临时停牌（Tạm ngừng giao dịch）、暂停交易（Đình chỉ giao dịch）五级状态，由 HOSE 依信息披露 / 财报 / 审计意见等触发条件施加与解除
trading_halt_mechanism.en: Market-wide: VNX may temporarily halt or suspend operation of the trading system under Article 49(1) of the Law on Securities, with resumption under Article 49(2). Stock-level: Chapter VI of QĐ22 provides a five-tier status ladder — Warning (Cảnh báo), Control (Kiểm soát), Trading restriction (Hạn chế giao dịch), Trading halt (Tạm ngừng giao dịch) and Trading suspension (Đình chỉ giao dịch) — imposed and lifted by HOSE on disclosure/financial-statement/audit-opinion triggers

sources.title: VNX QĐ 22 第16条（引用《证券法》第49条）+ 第六章第40–44条（个股状态阶梯）

trading_halt_mechanism.quote: Việc tạm ngừng, đình chỉ hoạt động giao dịch trên hệ thống giao dịch thực hiện theo quy định tại khoản 1 Điều 49 Luật Chứng khoán. Việc khôi phục hoạt động giao dịch trên hệ thống giao dịch sau khi tạm ngừng, đình chỉ thực hiện theo quy định tại khoản 2 Điều 49 Luật Chứng khoán.

spec.note: 已撮合成交仅在两种情形下可被作废，且须 HOSE 报 VNX、同时报请并经 SSC 批准：① 交易系统因不可抗力（系统故障、天灾、火灾等）出错；② 已成交违反交易规定，严重影响投资者合法权益或整个市场。无「偏离参考价 X%」的量化门槛、无固定复核时限。协议交易一经执行不得修改 / 撤销（第27条）

error_trade_rule.zh: 已撮合成交（或已记录的协议交易）原则上终局。仅当①系统因不可抗力出错，或②成交严重违反交易规定、危害投资者权益或市场时，HOSE 报 VNX 并报经 SSC 批准后作废该笔交易。无量化偏离阈值、无固定复核时限。协议交易执行后不得修改 / 撤销
error_trade_rule.en: A matched trade (or a recorded put-through trade) is in principle final. It may be cancelled only where (i) the trading system erred due to force majeure (system failure, natural disaster, fire, etc.) or (ii) the trade seriously breaches trading rules and harms investors' interests or the market — with HOSE reporting to VNX and obtaining SSC approval. There is no quantitative price-deviation threshold and no fixed review window. Put-through trades cannot be amended or cancelled once executed

sources.title: VNX QĐ 22 第18条（交易的确立与作废）+ 第27条（协议交易不得修改 / 撤销）

error_trade_rule.quote: SGDCK báo cáo SGDCKVN, đồng thời báo cáo, kiến nghị UBCKNN thực hiện loại bỏ đối với giao dịch đã được xác lập sau khi được UBCKNN chấp thuận trong các trường hợp sau đây: a) Hệ thống giao dịch gặp sự cố vì các nguyên nhân bất khả kháng như lỗi hệ thống, thiên tai, hỏa hoạn... b) Giao dịch đã được xác lập vi phạm quy định giao dịch, ảnh hưởng nghiêm trọng đến quyền và lợi ích hợp pháp của nhà đầu tư hoặc toàn bộ giao dịch trên thị trường. ... Giao dịch thoả thuận đã thực hiện trên hệ thống giao dịch không được phép sửa, huỷ.

intraday_reversal.zh: 无当日回转（T+0）。现货证券交收周期 T+2（见第八章），买入证券须待交收到账后方可卖出。通函 120/2020/TT-BTC 第10条为「当日交易」（day trading，需签订当日交易合同）预留了法律依据，但 KRX 系统 2025 年上线后 T+0 仍在研究、未实际推出
intraday_reversal.en: No intraday reversal (T+0). Cash securities settle T+2 (see chapter 8), and a bought security can only be sold after settlement. Article 10 of Circular 120/2020/TT-BTC reserves a legal basis for "day trading" (requiring a day-trading contract), but even after the KRX system went live in 2025, T+0 remains under study and has not been deployed

sources.title: 财政部通函 120/2020/TT-BTC 英译第10条（Day trading）
The Vietnam Stock Exchange 2026（the-shiv，KRX 系统上线后 T+0 / 卖空仍在路线图上）

intraday_reversal.quote: Investor can conduct day trading after entered into day trading contract with securities company eligible to provide the service of securities loan. ... Investor shall place trading orders and ensure that total number of a securities in sell orders must be equal to total number of such securities in buy orders within a trading date and vice versa.

spec.note: 裸卖空禁止。通函 120/2020/TT-BTC 第11条为「担保卖空」（secured short sale，须先经 VSDC 证券借贷系统借入证券）预留法律依据，但该机制连同证券借贷、当日交易一样，KRX 系统上线后仍未实际推出；截至 2026 年越南市场实务上不能卖空

short_selling.zh: 实务上禁止。通函 120/2020/TT-BTC 第11条规定「担保卖空」须通过 VSDC 证券借贷系统借入证券、签订借贷合同，但该机制尚未在越南市场落地运行；裸卖空一律禁止
short_selling.en: Banned in practice. Article 11 of Circular 120/2020/TT-BTC provides for a "secured short sale" requiring securities to be borrowed via the securities lending system at VSDC under a loan contract, but this mechanism is not yet operational in the Vietnamese market; naked short selling is prohibited outright

sources.title: 财政部通函 120/2020/TT-BTC 英译第11条（Secured short sale transaction）
The Vietnam Stock Exchange 2026（the-shiv，卖空 / 证券借贷仍未推出）

short_selling.quote: Securities loan transaction contracts on the securities loan and lending system at the Vietnam Securities Depository and Clearing Corporation to conduct short sale transactions must contain at least a minimum content of collateral, loan interest rates, loan term, loan extension, collateral handling when investors fail to return securities

block_trade.zh: 协议交易（giao dịch thỏa thuận / put-through）：一方录入、对手方确认；HOSE 大宗（lô lớn）最低 20,000 股；成交价须在当日 ±7% / ±20% 涨跌幅内；协议交易时段 09h00–11h30 与 13h00–15h00；新上市首日、连续 25 交易日以上停牌证券在整手撮合价确立前不适用协议交易
block_trade.en: Put-through (giao dịch thỏa thuận): one side enters, the counterparty confirms; HOSE large lot (lô lớn) minimum 20,000 shares; the price must be within the day's ±7%/±20% band; put-through runs 09:00–11:30 and 13:00–15:00; not available on a newly-listed stock's first day or for securities suspended 25 or more consecutive trading days until a round-lot match price is set

sources.title: VNX QĐ 22 第24–27条（协议交易）+ 附录 II（协议交易时段 / 大宗单位）

block_trade.quote: Giao dịch thỏa thuận không áp dụng trong ngày giao dịch đầu tiên của cổ phiếu niêm yết, chứng chỉ quỹ ETF, chứng chỉ quỹ đóng, chứng quyền có bảo đảm niêm yết và chứng khoán bị tạm ngừng, đình chỉ giao dịch liên tiếp từ 25 ngày giao dịch cho đến khi có giá được xác lập từ kết quả của khớp lệnh lô chẵn. Giao dịch thỏa thuận ... phải tuân theo quy định về biên độ dao động giá trong ngày. Giao dịch thỏa thuận được thực hiện theo nguyên tắc bên bán hoặc bên mua nhập lệnh giao dịch vào hệ thống và bên còn lại xác nhận giao dịch thỏa thuận.

order_book_transparency.zh: 全展示订单簿，无非展示订单类型。连续竞价盘口向市场公开三档最优买 / 卖报价及对应数量；集合竞价期间公开预计撮合价与撮合后剩余的三档最优买 / 卖报价及数量。不支持冰山单 / 隐藏限价单。外资买单按剩余可买额度计入各价位的市场买量显示
order_book_transparency.en: A fully-displayed order book with no non-displayed order types. In continuous trading the book publishes the three best bid/ask levels and their sizes; during an auction it publishes the indicative match price plus the three best remaining bid/ask levels and sizes post-uncrossing. Iceberg and hidden limit orders are not supported. Foreign-investor buy orders are added to the displayed market buy volume at each price up to the remaining foreign room
order_book_transparency.detail: 「三档最优」依 QĐ22 第14(5)条（引用通函 96/2020/TT-BTC 第37条）。全展示、无隐藏单类型是与欧美订单簿（NYSE 非展示单、Xetra 冰山单等）的显著差异，与 jp-jpx / hk-hkex / cn-sse 等东亚现货订单簿一致。

sources.title: VNX QĐ 22 第14(5)条（披露三档最优买卖报价）+ 第28(3)条（外资买单显示）

order_book_transparency.quote: ba mức giá chào mua, chào bán tốt nhất trong đợt khớp lệnh định kỳ theo quy định tại điểm c khoản 1 Điều 37 Thông tư số 96/2020/TT-BTC là ba mức giá chào mua, chào bán tốt nhất dự kiến còn lại sau khi khớp lệnh kèm theo khối lượng đặt mua, bán dự kiến còn lại sau khi khớp lệnh

dark_pool.zh: 无。越南无与交易所并列的独立暗池 / MTF；场外只有《证券法》与登记结算通函允许的少数「系统外过户」（继承、赠与、要约收购、法院裁定等），非匿名连续交易场所
dark_pool.en: None. Vietnam has no independent dark pool or MTF alongside the exchange; off-exchange transfers are limited to the few "outside-the-system ownership transfers" allowed by the Law on Securities and the registration/settlement circular (inheritance, gift, tender offer, court order, etc.), not an anonymous continuous trading venue
dark_pool.detail: 消极认定 + QĐ22 第14(1)条「上市证券在 SGDCK 交易系统交易，系统外过户仅限通函 119/2020/TT-BTC 第6(2)条列举情形」的推论。

sources.title: VNX QĐ 22 第14(1)条（上市证券在系统内交易，系统外过户的例外）

spec.note: 做市限于备兑权证（CW）发行人对其权证、以及 ETF；做市商与 VNX 签做市合同、按合同承担双边或单边报价义务（含最大买卖价差、报价维持时长等）；做市商仅下限价单，可同时做市与自营。普通股票无做市商

market_maker_scheme.zh: 有限做市商制度：交易会员经登记可对特定证券做市，主要用于备兑权证（发行人义务做市）与 ETF。做市商须诚信履行做市职能，按 VNX 规则与做市合同双边 / 单边报价，只下限价单；VNX 可对未尽责的做市商中止或终止其做市。普通上市股票无场内做市商
market_maker_scheme.en: A limited market-maker scheme: registered trading members may make markets in designated securities, mainly for covered warrants (issuer market-making obligation) and ETFs. Market makers must perform the function in good faith, quote two-way or one-way under VNX rules and the market-making contract, and place limit orders only; VNX may suspend or terminate a market maker that fails its duties. Ordinary listed shares have no on-exchange market maker

sources.title: 财政部通函 120/2020/TT-BTC 英译第12条（Market making transactions）

market_maker_scheme.quote: Trading members taking part in market making shall only place limit orders for market making trading. Trading members taking part in market making can simultaneously conduct market making trading and self-trading provided that price principle must be ensured ... In case a securities number needs liquidity, market-making period, quote methods, limit of difference between the bid price and the asked price, price rate-of-change, maintenance period of quote and cases in which trading is suspended shall apply regulations of the Stock Exchange and market making contract

connect_schemes.zh: 无。越南与其他市场无沪港通式互联互通；外国投资者通过在越南证券公司开立的越南盾间接投资资本账户与证券交易账户直接参与本地市场，受外资持股上限（room）实时约束
connect_schemes.en: None. Vietnam has no Stock-Connect-style cross-border link with other markets; foreign investors participate directly in the local market through a VND indirect-investment capital account and a securities trading account opened at a Vietnamese securities company, subject to the real-time foreign ownership limit (room)
connect_schemes.detail: 消极认定；QĐ22 第28条只规范外资在本地系统内的交易与 room 计算，无跨境通道条款。

sources.title: VNX QĐ 22 第28条（外国投资者的证券交易 / room 计算）

items.name_native: Niêm yết (Sở Giao dịch Chứng khoán Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh)
items.financial_threshold: 实缴注册资本 ≥ 300 亿越南盾且市值 ≥ 300 亿越南盾；上市前年 ROE ≥ 5% 且前两年经营盈利；无逾期一年以上债务、无累计亏损；至少 15%（注册资本 ≥ 1 万亿越南盾时为 10%）有表决权股由 ≥ 100 名非大股东持有
items.target_companies: 大中型公众公司；HOSE 为越南规模最大的交易所

review_system.zh: 核准制：上市登记由交易所（VNX / HOSE）依政府令 155/2020/NĐ-CP 与 VNX 上市业务规则审核批准；发行环节的公开发行由国家证券委员会（SSC）发放公开发行注册证书。与交易所审核并行的监管注册以 SSC 为准
review_system.en: Approval-based: listing registration is reviewed and approved by the exchange (VNX/HOSE) under Decree 155/2020/NĐ-CP and the VNX listing regulation; the public-offering leg requires a certificate of registration for public offering from the State Securities Commission (SSC)
review_system.detail: 越南是核准制而非注册制——公开发行须经 SSC 逐案发放注册证书（《证券法》第25条），上市须经交易所逐案批准。enum 取 approval。

sources.title: 政府令 155/2020/NĐ-CP 第109(1)条 + Law on Securities 英译 Art 25（公开发行注册证书）

review_system.quote: Là công ty cỗ phần có vốn điều lệ đã góp tại thời điểm đăng ký niêm yết từ 30 tỷ đồng trở lên căn cứ trên báo cáo tài chính gần nhất được kiểm toán, đồng thời giá trị vốn hóa đạt tối thiểu 30 tỷ đồng

listing_process_duration.detail: 越南《证券法》与政府令 155 未设从上市申请到挂牌的单一法定总时长；交易所收到完整申请后有法定审核时限（政府令 155 第111条），本次未从 OCR 定位到含阿拉伯数字的干净时限句，spec 整个不填，记 OPEN-QUESTIONS。实务上从递交到挂牌通常数月。

sources.title: 政府令 155/2020/NĐ-CP 第111条（上市登记程序）

transfer_between_boards.zh: 强制退市但仍符合公众公司条件的股票，须转入河内证券交易所的 UPCoM 注册交易市场（政府令 155 第120(2)条 / 第133条）。UPCoM 公司满足政府令 155 第109条条件的可申请到 HOSE 上市。HOSE 与 HNX 之间无正式转板通道（两所定位不同、HNX 主要为 UPCoM / 债券 / 衍生品）
transfer_between_boards.en: A stock that is mandatorily delisted but still qualifies as a public company must move to the UPCoM registered-trading market at the Hanoi Stock Exchange (Decree 155 Art 120(2) / Art 133). A UPCoM company meeting the Art 109 conditions may apply to list on HOSE. There is no formal board-transfer channel between HOSE and HNX (the two exchanges have different roles — HNX mainly runs UPCoM/bonds/derivatives)

sources.title: 政府令 155/2020/NĐ-CP 第120(2)条（强制退市股转 UPCoM）

transfer_between_boards.quote: Cổ phiếu của công ty hủy bỏ niêm yết nhưng vẫn đáp ứng điều kiện là công ty đại chúng phải đăng ký giao dịch trên hệ thống giao dịch Upcom theo quy định tại Điều 133 Nghị định này.

continuing_obligations.zh: 上市公司须持续满足公众公司治理要求（《证券法》第40–41条）、按通函 96/2020/TT-BTC 与 VNX 规则作定期与临时信息披露、保持最低公众持股与 100 名非大股东门槛、按 HOSE 规则接受警告 / 控制 / 限制交易等监管状态管理（QĐ22 第六章）
continuing_obligations.en: A listed company must continuously meet public-company governance requirements (Law on Securities Arts 40–41), make periodic and ad-hoc disclosures under Circular 96/2020/TT-BTC and VNX rules, maintain the minimum public float and the 100-non-major-shareholder threshold, and be subject to HOSE's status ladder — warning/control/trading-restriction, etc. (QĐ22 Chapter VI)
continuing_obligations.detail: 具体持续义务清单待从 VNX 上市业务规则与通函 96/2020 逐条核实。

sources.title: VNX QĐ 22 第六章（个股监管状态：警告 / 控制 / 限制交易 / 停牌 / 暂停）

suspension_resumption.zh: 个股停牌由 HOSE 依 QĐ22 第43条（临时停牌 Tạm ngừng giao dịch）与第44条（暂停交易 Đình chỉ giao dịch）施加，触发条件包括未按期披露、被列入控制 / 限制交易后仍未改善、重大不确定事件等；复牌须整改并经 HOSE 决定。停牌 / 暂停连续 ≥25 个交易日的证券复牌首日适用 ±20% 涨跌幅（见 market_structure.price_limits）
suspension_resumption.en: Stock suspension is imposed by HOSE under QĐ22 Art 43 (Tạm ngừng giao dịch / trading halt) and Art 44 (Đình chỉ giao dịch / trading suspension), on grounds including late disclosure, failure to remedy after being placed under control/restriction, and material uncertainty; resumption requires remediation and a HOSE decision. A security halted/suspended for ≥25 consecutive trading days uses the ±20% band on its first day back (see market_structure.price_limits)

sources.title: VNX QĐ 22 第43–44条（临时停牌 / 暂停交易）

delisting_conditions.zh: 强制退市（政府令 155 第120条）触发条件包括：连续 3 年经营亏损、或累计亏损超过实缴注册资本、或最近一期审计财报净资产为负；连续 3 年审计意见为否定 / 拒绝表示意见（或连续 3 年保留意见）；连续 3 年迟报年度财报；丧失公众公司资格；主营业务停顿 ≥1 年；在交易所无交易满 12 个月；伪造上市文件；因《证券法》第12条禁止行为被处罚；严重违反信息披露义务等。自愿退市（第121条）须经股东大会批准且上市满 2 年以上
delisting_conditions.en: Mandatory delisting (Decree 155 Art 120) is triggered by, among others: losses for 3 consecutive years, or accumulated losses exceeding paid-up charter capital, or negative equity in the latest audited financial statements; an adverse or disclaimed audit opinion for 3 consecutive years (or a qualified opinion for 3 consecutive years); late annual financial statements for 3 consecutive years; loss of public-company status; cessation of main business for ≥1 year; no trading at the exchange for 12 months; forged listing documents; sanction for prohibited acts under Article 12 of the Law on Securities; serious disclosure violations. Voluntary delisting (Art 121) requires shareholder-meeting approval and a minimum of 2 years listed

sources.title: 政府令 155/2020/NĐ-CP 第120条（强制退市）+ 第121条（自愿退市）

delisting_conditions.quote: Kết quả sản xuất, kinh doanh bị thua lỗ trong 03 năm liên tục hoặc tổng số lỗ luỹ kế vượt quá số vốn điều lệ thực góp hoặc vốn chủ sở hữu âm trong báo cáo tài chính kiểm toán năm gần nhất trước thời điểm xem xét ... Tổ chức kiểm toán không chấp nhận thực hiện kiểm toán hoặc có ý kiến kiểm toán trái ngược hoặc từ chối cho ý kiến ... Cổ phiếu không có giao dịch tại Sở giao dịch chứng khoán trong thời hạn 12 tháng

delisting_process.zh: HOSE 作出退市决定并公告；符合条件的强制退市股票在退市决定日起继续交易一段整理期后摘牌（见 delisting_transition_period），仍属公众公司的转 UPCoM（见 transfer_between_boards）；被退市组织可依政府令 155 第122条在满足条件后申请重新上市
delisting_process.en: HOSE issues and announces the delisting decision; an eligible mandatorily-delisted stock keeps trading for a transition period from the decision date before removal (see delisting_transition_period), and if still a public company moves to UPCoM (see transfer_between_boards); a delisted organization may re-apply to list under Decree 155 Art 122 once it meets the conditions

sources.title: 政府令 155/2020/NĐ-CP 第120(4)条 + 第122条（重新上市）

spec.note: 强制退市股票自退市决定日起继续交易「最多 30 日」再摘牌；因吊销营业执照、无交易满 12 个月、破产解散、伪造文件、《证券法》第12条违法、被暂停主营等特定事由退市的不适用此过渡期（政府令 155 第120(4)条列举的例外情形）

delisting_transition_period.zh: 强制退市股票自退市决定日起继续交易最多 30 日后摘牌；特定严重事由（吊照 / 无交易满 12 个月 / 破产 / 伪造文件 / 第12条违法等）退市的不适用该整理期，直接摘牌
delisting_transition_period.en: A mandatorily-delisted stock continues trading for up to 30 days from the delisting decision before removal; this transition period does not apply where delisting is on certain serious grounds (licence revocation, no trading for 12 months, bankruptcy, forged documents, Article 12 breaches, etc.), in which case the stock is removed immediately

sources.title: 政府令 155/2020/NĐ-CP 第120(4)条（退市整理期最多 30 日 + 例外）

ccp_name.zh: 越南证券存托与清算总公司（VSDC，Vietnam Securities Depository and Clearing Corporation）——现货市场执行多边净额清算但无更替（novation）；VSDC 同时是越南衍生品市场的中央对手方
ccp_name.en: Vietnam Securities Depository and Clearing Corporation (VSDC) — performs multilateral netting for the cash market but without novation; VSDC is also the central counterparty for Vietnam's derivatives market
ccp_name.detail: 依 Circular 120/2020/TT-BTC 第6条，现货证券清算结算在「尚未按中央对手方（CCP）机制实施」期间，投资者经账户交易与交收、无需清算保证金账户——即现货市场目前不走 CCP 更替。向现货 CCP 过渡是 KRX 系统 / FTSE 升级配套改革的方向（拟以新通函取代 Circular 119/2020）。衍生品市场 VSDC 依《证券法》第55–56条作 CCP，设清算会员、清算基金与保证金（见 clearing.derivatives，主要属 HNX 衍生品市场）。

sources.title: 财政部通函 120/2020/TT-BTC 英译第6条（CCP 机制实施前后的账户安排）

ccp_name.quote: During the time the securities clearing and settlement has not been implemented under the central clearing partner mechanism, the investor shall carry out securities transactions, and make payment for securities transactions via their account and securities depository accounts without having to open clearing margin accounts.

csd_name.zh: 越南证券存托与清算总公司（VSDC）——上市证券必须集中登记与集中存托于 VSDC，方可交易；VSDC 依总理决定 26/2022/QĐ-TTg（2022-12-16）在原越南证券存托中心（VSD）基础上改制设立
csd_name.en: Vietnam Securities Depository and Clearing Corporation (VSDC) — listed securities must be centrally registered and centrally deposited at VSDC before trading; VSDC was established by PM Decision No. 26/2022/QD-TTg (16 Dec 2022) on the basis of transforming the former Vietnam Securities Depository (VSD)

sources.title: Law on Securities No. 54/2019/QH14 英译（Art 61–62：集中登记与集中存托）

csd_name.quote: Securities of public companies and securities of other organizations listed and registered for trading on the securities trading system must be deposited in a concentrated manner at the Vietnam Securities Depository and Clearing Corporation before being traded

guarantee_model.zh: 现货市场为多层结算保障防线、无中央对手方更替：交收违约时先动用违约会员自有资源与投资者担保品，再动用「结算支持基金」（由存托会员按财政部规定缴纳、由 VSDC 单独管理），并可动用 VSDC 依法可动用的支付支持来源；具体处置程序载于 VSDC《证券交易清算结算业务规则》（39/QĐ-HĐTV，2025-04-29）。衍生品市场另设由清算会员出资的「清算基金」与保证金制度，VSDC 充当 CCP
guarantee_model.en: The cash market runs on multiple lines of defence with no central-counterparty novation: on a settlement default, the defaulting member's own resources and investors' collateral are used first, then the "payment assistance fund" (contributed by depository members per Ministry of Finance rules, managed separately by VSDC), and VSDC's lawful payment-support sources; the detailed procedure is set out in VSDC's Regulations on clearing and settling securities transactions (Decision No. 39/QD-HDTV, 29 Apr 2025). The derivatives market separately maintains a "clearing fund" funded by clearing members plus a margin regime, with VSDC acting as CCP
guarantee_model.detail: 定级：quote 里未逐字出现 central counterparty / novation 描述现货市场（反而 Circular 120 第6条明说 CCP 机制尚未实施），依《证券法》第66条结算支持基金 + Circular 120 第6条判为 lines_of_defence，confidence: medium。

guarantee_model.quote: Payment assistance funds are formed from contributions of depository members for making payments on depository members' behalf in case they are temporarily insolvent to pay securities transactions. Payment assistance funds are managed by the Vietnam Securities Depository and Clearing Corporation separately from its assets.

initial_margin_practice.zh: 现货市场无 CCP 层面的初始保证金（Circular 120 第6条：CCP 机制实施前投资者无需开立清算保证金账户）。交易端的信用交易（融资买入 margin trading）由证券公司按与投资者的合同收取初始与维持保证金——初始保证金比例、追保时限、平仓处置由合同约定、SSC 制定指引；外国投资者不得进行融资交易
initial_margin_practice.en: The cash market has no CCP-level initial margin (Circular 120 Art 6: before the CCP mechanism is implemented, investors need not open a clearing margin account). On the trading side, margin trading (buying on margin) is run by securities companies under contract with investors, who set the initial and maintenance margin — margin ratios, top-up deadlines and forced-sale handling are set by contract with SSC guidance; foreign investors may not conduct margin trading

sources.title: 财政部通函 120/2020/TT-BTC 英译第9条（Margin trading）+ 第6条

initial_margin_practice.quote: The investor is obliged to ensure initial margin rate, margin rate maintenance in accordance with the contract signed with securities company. When the margin ratio on the investor's margin trading account falls below the maintenance margin rate, the securities company shall issue an additional margin order. ... Foreign investor is not allowed to conduct margin trading.

maintenance_margin_practice.zh: 见 initial_margin_practice——融资交易的维持保证金比例由证券公司与投资者的合同约定，低于维持比例即触发追加保证金指令，未补足证券公司有权按合同处置担保证券
maintenance_margin_practice.en: See initial_margin_practice — the maintenance margin ratio for margin trading is set by contract between the securities company and the investor; falling below it triggers an additional-margin order, and on failure to top up the securities company may dispose of the collateral securities per the contract

sources.title: 财政部通函 120/2020/TT-BTC 英译第9(6)条（维持保证金与追保 / 处置）

maintenance_margin_practice.quote: When the margin ratio on the investor's margin trading account falls below the maintenance margin rate, the securities company shall issue an additional margin order. ... In case the investor fails to make the additional margin, securities company is entitled to sell collateral securities according to provisions stated in the contract for opening margin trading account.

mark_to_market_frequency.zh: 现货市场无 CCP 盯市概念（无 CCP 更替、无清算保证金账户）。衍生品市场每日盯市（见 clearing.derivatives，属 HNX 衍生品市场）
mark_to_market_frequency.en: The cash market has no CCP mark-to-market concept (no novation, no clearing margin account). The derivatives market is marked to market daily (see clearing.derivatives, which is the HNX derivatives market)

delivery_method.zh: 现货市场：买卖双方经 VSDC 存托账户体系簿记过户交收证券，结算银行按 VSDC 指令通过存托会员在结算银行的存款账户体系付款，证券过户与资金支付同步（DVP）。BIDV 为股票 / ETF / 权证等一般现货证券的结算银行，越南国家银行营业部为债务工具、越南外贸银行（VCB）为私募债券的结算银行
delivery_method.en: Cash market: securities are settled by book-entry transfer via VSDC's depository account system, with the settlement bank paying per VSDC's instructions through depository members' deposit accounts at the settlement bank, and securities transfer occurring simultaneously with cash payment (DVP). BIDV is the settlement bank for stocks/ETFs/warrants and other general underlying securities; the State Bank of Vietnam's Exchange for debt instruments and Vietcombank (VCB) for privately-placed bonds

sources.title: VSDC 英文站「Clearing and Settlement」服务页（结算原则、结算银行分工、DVP）

delivery_method.quote: The State Bank of Vietnam's Exchange is the settlement bank for debt instrument transactions; VCB Bank is the clearing bank for private placement transactions; BIDV Bank is the clearing bank for the remaining underlying securities. ... the buyer is guaranteed to receive the securities upon payment, and the seller is guaranteed to receive the money upon transfer of securities.

last_trading_day_rule.zh: 现货市场无「最后交易日」概念（无到期证券）。衍生品市场的最后交易日 / 最后结算日规则见 clearing.derivatives（属 HNX 衍生品市场）
last_trading_day_rule.en: The cash market has no "last trading day" concept (no expiring securities). Last-trading-day / last-settlement-day rules for the derivatives market are in clearing.derivatives (the HNX derivatives market)

default_management.zh: 现货交收违约处置为多层防线（无 CCP 更替）：① 违约会员自有资源与投资者担保品；② 结算支持基金（存托会员缴纳）；③ VSDC 依法可动用的支付支持来源；④ 财政部规定的处置措施。绝对额不披露
default_management.en: Cash-market settlement default is handled through layered defences (no CCP novation): (1) the defaulting member's own resources and investors' collateral; (2) the payment assistance fund (depository member contributions); (3) VSDC's lawful payment-support sources; (4) handling measures prescribed by the Ministry of Finance. Absolute amounts are not disclosed
